\begin{document}
In the Boltzmann equation, $f^{0}(\epsilon)$ denotes the equilibrium Fermi distribution at chemical
potential zero. Particle-hole symmetry of the equilibrium distribution reads
\begin{equation}
f^{0}(-\epsilon) - \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2} - f^{0}(\epsilon) .
\label{eq:ph}
\end{equation}
